references.observed: Actually inspected ordinary oblique color aerial: the river-facing broad columned pediment and stair front the rounded/hemicycle roof. Behind it an open ceremonial court is framed by low ranges with pale walls and green roofs. Attached secondary/administrative ranges surround two additional large roof-free courts. The separate-looking garden/Lassay frontage lies beside the principal river block; resolve its actual connected mapped ownership rather than dropping the attached rear ranges. No archival survey was consulted.

Actually inspected close north/Seine facade: twelve tall Corinthian-style columns beneath a broad triangular stone pediment, deep porch with closed doors behind columns, broad stair/side cheeks, lower flanking wall masses and substantial entablature. Original simplified capitals and blank/original pediment relief will replace all statues, inscriptions and heraldry.

Actually inspected official courtyard picture: four-column central pedimented entry, tall recessed arched glazing and paired/returned columns on side ranges, gray mansard dormer band with green upper metal roof, open stone balustrades, small basement vents and short supported entry steps. Large open court and spherical artwork are context; do not copy sculpture or figures.
